description: This file defines structures, types, and function prototypes related to input stream handling in FreeType, including stream object structures, class descriptors, and function pointer types for reading and seeking within streams.

classes.name: FT_Stream
classes.description: Handle to an input stream object, used for reading data streams.

classes.name: FT_Stream_ClassRec
classes.description: Class descriptor for input stream classes, containing method pointers for reading and seeking.

classes.name: FT_StreamRec
classes.description: Structure representing an input stream, including data pointers, size, and position.

methods.name: ft_stream_new_memory
methods.description: Creates a new memory-based stream from a given data buffer.

methods.name: ft_stream_new_iso
methods.description: Creates a new stream from an ISO file given its path.
